itin.description: The Individual Taxpayer Identification Number the notice confirms, exactly as printed

notice.description: The notice's own identifiers, from the block at the top right

notice_date.description: The date of the notice, as printed

form.description: The form the notice responds to, e.g. 'W-7'

case_reference_number.description: The case reference number, exactly as printed

page_count.description: The page marker printed in the header, e.g. 'Page 1 of 2'

recipient.description: Who the notice is for and where it was mailed

full_name.description: The full name given in the ITIN and personal information table, first middle and last joined by single spaces

mailing_name.description: The name as printed in the mailing address block

mailing_address.description: The street, city, state and ZIP of the recipient's mailing address, as one line

date_of_birth.description: The recipient's date of birth, as printed

issuer.description: The issuing agency and how to contact it

agency.description: The issuing agency, e.g. 'Internal Revenue Service'

assistance_phone.description: The phone number given for assistance

international_phone.description: The phone number given for international callers

mailing_address.description: The address given for writing to the agency, as one line
